limits: Exact microsecond deadlines are established by clock-controlled public server fixtures, not browser timer precision.
Browser contexts and application delivery fixtures do not establish physical OS suspension or the supported browser/OS/network matrix.
Reference-hardware/network metrics, capacity, two-person manual playtests and full Stage 6/7 acceptance remain later tickets.

failureRetention.firstRaceAttempt: Initial delayed scenario returned to the main menu while other work ran; that exact interference cause was not measured. Recovering verified0 recurred under frozen source and was traced to epoch-local diagnostics overwriting the total. Public regression reproduced it; cumulative diagnostic repair retains epoch-local CRC rules and all original browser assertions. Original failures remain retained.
failureRetention.equalTime: Independent Spec finding reproduced before repair; expiry-first produced forfeit at 2000000us instead of abandonment. Both permutations pass after repair.
failureRetention.staleInput: Old stream overwrote replacement input ownership before repair; public regression now proves current stream receives both rounds and obsolete stream zero frames.
failureRetention.raceDetector: Existing maintenance fixture called expireLocked without mutex. It now holds the owner mutex, and full transport race detection passes.
failureRetention.boostedLeave: Public input/outcome regression reproduced NOS cleared at the previous tick before cutoff. At1500000us a legitimate gameplay win became opponentforfeit. Fixed by retaining controls through StopAt integration, with just-before/exact/after cases independently reviewed.
